timing.interpretation: Exploratory protocol recorded before this analyst inspects responses; not a prospective preregistration before collection. Record later amendments, reasons, timing and prior exposure to results.

required_confirmations: Documented consent or applicable participation authorization
Confirmed familiarity with the selected system
One recognized system route and compatible administered instrument
inclusion.confirmation_source: Restricted administration records may supply confirmations absent from the questionnaire; profile scores are not proof of consent or familiarity.
inclusion.unresolved_eligibility: Hold out until resolved; retain reason and count. Do not silently treat unknown as eligible or invent confirmations.
inclusion.deduplication: Remove only proven duplicate export rows/submissions using restricted provenance. Do not deduplicate identical rating vectors, timestamps alone, or matching profiles. Hold unresolved duplicate groups out; document disposition without inspecting favorable/unfavorable content.
inclusion.identity_limit: Anonymous submissions cannot automatically be counted as unique people. Report submissions separately from confirmed distinct evaluators; use submission-level IDs for traceability, not a claim of person-level identification.
inclusion.primary: Available valid selected-route items from eligible, route-valid retained submissions.
inclusion.sensitivity: Repeat the same analysis on submissions with every selected-route Q1-Q5 item valid.
inclusion.route_conflict: Quarantine any submission with unknown/multiple route selection or nonblank rating items outside its selected route until instrument/export mapping is resolved.
inclusion.profile_missing: Retain otherwise eligible submissions; report unknown profile values rather than imputing or discarding ratings.
inclusion.flow_reconciliation: Every raw row receives one mutually exclusive final flow status and one primary reason; secondary flags retained. Raw rows = included + excluded + held_pending.

cell_rules.expected: Selected system's prepared cases crossed with Q1-Q5; verify actual instrument version and case mapping before analysis.
cell_rules.structural_blank: Unselected-route blank rating/comment cells are not eligible opportunities and are excluded from all rating denominators.
cell_rules.missing: Blank selected-route rating: missing eligible opportunity; retain submission for other valid items.
cell_rules.invalid: Any selected-route value other than one exact integer category 1-5 after whitespace trimming is invalid; preserve raw value, exclude that item and report count. No rounding, clipping or inference.
cell_rules.opportunities: For each case/item, eligible opportunities = retained submissions on that case's system; valid + missing + invalid must equal opportunities.
cell_rules.comments: Blank selected-route comments indicate no optional comment, not disagreement. Off-route comments are mapping flags for restricted review, not selected-system evidence.

ordinal_summary.categories: Report all five counts and percentages among valid items; report opportunities, missing, invalid and valid n separately.
ordinal_summary.quantile: Use the non-interpolated inverse empirical CDF: Q(p) = smallest category k with cumulative proportion through k >= p, for p=0.25,0.50,0.75. For even n the median is the lower category median, not the arithmetic midpoint.
ordinal_summary.iqr: Display Q(0.50) with [Q(0.25), Q(0.75)] as the interquartile category interval. Do not interpret category spacing as equal-scale distances.
ordinal_summary.empty: When valid n is zero, mark proportions and quantiles unavailable, not zero; still report opportunity/missing/invalid counts.

aggregation.case_item: One distribution per case and Q item, giving each retained valid submission one vote within that case.
aggregation.story_item: Average the case/item category proportions equally across that story's cases with at least one valid rating.
aggregation.system_item: Average story/item distributions equally across that system's stories with at least one observed case/item distribution.
aggregation.study_item: Average the observed system/item distributions equally; report contributing system/story/case counts and absent strata. Never relabel partial coverage as all four systems.
aggregation.hierarchical_quantiles: Apply the same inverse CDF to the averaged category distribution; do not average case medians or flatten all ratings into the primary study distribution.
aggregation.respondent_item: Within each retained submission's selected route, summarize its case ratings separately for Q1-Q5; no across-item score and no public row-level profile/rating linkage.
aggregation.zero_positive_story: Stories without selected pairs are outside expert-rating opportunities, not zero scores or missing expert cases. No claims about rejected or unassessed patterns.
aggregation.unbalanced_design: The primary study distribution balances cases within stories, stories within systems and systems within study. A larger route does not automatically receive larger study weight.
aggregation.dependence: Ratings share evaluators and cases. Do not count item ratings as independent participants or claim population representativeness; omit inferential tests and confidence intervals in this exploratory protocol.

agreement.stratification: Separately by system and Q item; units are ADR cases and raters are confirmed distinct evaluators on that system, not unverified anonymous submissions.
agreement.gate: Compute only with at least two confirmed distinct evaluators sharing a case and positive expected disagreement. Require an unambiguous rater-unit mapping. Otherwise report not estimable with the reason; never switch silently to a different coefficient.
agreement.coincidences: For a case u with m_u valid confirmed-rater ratings >= 2, add every ordered distinct-rater category pair (c,k) with weight 1/(m_u-1) to o_ck. Cases with fewer than two ratings contribute no coincidences.
agreement.ordinal_distance: Let n_c = sum_k o_ck and n = sum_c n_c over pairable cases. For c != k, delta(c,k) = (sum of n_g from min(c,k) through max(c,k), minus (n_c+n_k)/2)^2; delta(c,c)=0.
agreement.coefficient: D_o = sum_ck o_ck*delta(c,k)/n. D_e = sum_ck n_c*n_k*delta(c,k)/(n*(n-1)). Alpha = 1-D_o/D_e when n>1 and D_e>0.
agreement.coverage: Report confirmed rater count, total observed cases, pairable case count, valid confirmed-rater ratings in pairable cases, missingness, alpha and any non-estimability reason. No pooled cross-system alpha, threshold labels or confidence interval.
agreement.interpretation: Exploratory agreement/consistency, not agreement with the paper hypothesis, correctness or a pass/fail expert-validation test.

qualitative.unit: One nonblank eligible selected-route case comment, linked internally to submission/case IDs.
qualitative.coding: Two researchers independently code all eligible comments, then reconcile disagreements and retain both initial assignments, reconciliation reasons and final codes.
qualitative.codebook: Domains guide reading, not questionnaire constructs or guaranteed findings. Develop inductive subcodes, include critical/mixed/counterexample observations, record codebook versions, and recode affected comments after revisions. Multiple codes per comment permitted.
qualitative.counts: Report unique coded comments per theme, optional comment opportunities and nonblank total; also distinguish submissions/cases contributing when privacy permits. Multiple themes may exceed the comment total. No prevalence or representativeness claim.
qualitative.quotes: Use only short quotations with documented quotation authorization and de-identification review; otherwise summarize without quoting. Do not infer consent from survey completion.
qualitative.fallback: If independent dual coding cannot be executed, log the deviation and report the actual single-coder/reviewer procedure, not fictitious dual coding.

interpretation.criterion: Describe item-specific professional judgments, heterogeneity, coverage and qualitative reservations. No validated/not-validated label, majority success rule, composite score or post hoc threshold. Hypothesis support must be qualified by the actual item distributions and sampling limits.
interpretation.privacy: All publication-facing outputs need disclosure review. Do not publish respondent-level rows, small-cell profile combinations, or identifying comments. Withholding/coarsening must be documented without concealing critical findings; privacy rules must be finalized before public export.

outputs.source: Disposition log, profiles and administration confirmations.
outputs.computation: Reconcile row statuses; count route submissions, confirmed evaluators and profile categories with valid/unknown denominators.
outputs.display: Sample composition and flow; disclosure-reviewed categories only.

outputs.computation: System and balanced study distributions per item using the specified hierarchy; inverse-CDF median/quartiles, raw valid n and coverage.
outputs.display: Primary item summaries; distinguish weighted proportions from raw counts.

outputs.source: Eligible ratings, cell flags and prepared case/item grid.
outputs.computation: Every case/item: opportunities, valid/missing/invalid n, category counts/percentages and quantiles; no-data summaries unavailable.
outputs.display: Disclosure-reviewed aggregate case inventory; no respondent text/identifiers.

outputs.computation: Equal-case story and equal-story system distributions, quantiles and observed/expected coverage; never average medians.
outputs.display: Aggregate story/system audit supporting primary table.

outputs.computation: Stacked bars of all five ordered categories by system and balanced study summary, with coverage and identical scales.
outputs.display: Distribution visualization; do not plot missing groups as zero or favorable-only categories.

outputs.source: Confirmed-rater IDs joined to eligible ratings.
outputs.computation: Within-system/item ordinal alpha using the specified coincidence formula and gate; report coverage or non-estimability.
outputs.display: Conditional agreement with no pass/fail interpretation; no invented coefficient if identity/coverage is insufficient.

outputs.computation: Repeat case, hierarchy and item summaries unchanged; compare distributions and coverage with primary analysis.
outputs.display: Completeness sensitivity; if subset is empty, report unavailable.

outputs.source: Eligible comments, codebook, independent coding and reconciliation logs.
outputs.computation: Unique comments per theme with comment/opportunity denominators; preserve negative cases and multiple-code accounting.
outputs.display: Definitions and counts with privacy review; quotations only if separately authorized.

implementation_boundary: Task 1.8 records the protocol and output inventory only. Actual response ingestion, statistics, alpha, qualitative coding and figures are implemented and tested in Phase 3 after consent/governance and administered-instrument confirmation. No human results or mock results are produced here.
